subject.title: feat: add maref-governance extension for AI agent safety enforcement

question: Should MAREF governance be supported as an external plugin/ClawHub package, or should OpenClaw bundle and own its fail-closed sidecar dependency and operator-support contract?
rationale: This is a new optional security product surface with new configuration, an external production dependency, and intentional tool-blocking behavior; implementation correctness cannot establish the permanent ownership and upgrade policy.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Keep core generic and publish MAREF as an externally owned plugin after showing sidecar integration proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled integration
options.body: Explicitly approve core ownership, the exact dependency graph, the fail-closed upgrade contract, and the required runtime proof.

recommendation.title: External plugin first
recommendation.body: Keep core generic and publish MAREF as an externally owned plugin after showing sidecar integration proof.

likelyOwner.reason: A person-level owner could not be established reliably from the available current-main history evidence; route to the plugin SDK and extension-boundary owners.
